_what: Sites that hand a caught error's own message to a person. The list may only SHRINK: a new one fails the build, and a row for a site that no longer violates fails it too, so clearing one means fixing the code AND deleting its row.
_rule: A failure returned toward a webview or an agent carries a message written for an SC. Translated means a per-provider formatter, a domain error's own message, or an honest generic - never a caught error's .message passed through.
_the_judgement_this_cannot_make: Whether the words are THIS EXTENSION'S or a library's is invisible at the call site; it depends on what threw. componentUpdater passes its caught message through and is right to - every error reaching it was thrown by our code with a deliberate sentence. Replacing that with a generic on 2026-09-11 made the product worse and six tests said so.
